nodes.title: 1.Note
widgets_values: Today, I will introduce how to perform img2img using the Regional Sampler.

nodes.title: 2.Note
widgets_values:
This image was generated with DALL-E. I like the composition, but I am dissatisfied with the image quality.

So, I attempted to improve it with img2img, but it's not easy to enhance the quality while maintaining the composition.

nodes.title: 3.Note
widgets_values:
I have set up regions for the key elements in order to perform img2img using the Regional Sampler.

green region: Black beret
red region : Girl in a green hair and uniform
blue region: Girl in a red hair and blouse

When drawing the color mask, I intentionally left some space between regions to account for areas where overlap may occur. Overlap helps prevent artifacts at the boundaries between the base and regions.
